title: Health data
summary: Workouts, sleep and day metrics from the watch, through Health Connect and Garmin Connect.
description: Health Connect only carries what the Garmin Connect app writes there, so the two are one source arriving twice. Health Connect has data first; Garmin's own numbers are the ones trusted.

stories.as: someone who trains with a Garmin watch
stories.want: my workouts to appear in the diary without logging them
stories.soThat: their calories count without any effort from me

requirements.text: A session from Health Connect enters the diary as soon as it is read.

history.text: A session from Health Connect enters the diary at once, as provisional.
history.reason: Version 1 called it provisional, which only means something through HD-2.

requirements.text: Once Garmin Connect has a day, an activity or a night, its values replace Health Connect's, and later Health Connect writes leave them alone.
A workout field the user changed by hand is never overwritten by either source.

history.text: A field the user changed by hand is never overwritten by either source.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't give the scope: sleep and day metrics have no hand-edit protection.

requirements.text: A workout the user deleted by hand is never imported again.

history.text: A session the user deleted by hand is never imported again.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't give the scope: only workouts are recorded as deleted.

requirements.text: An imported session is matched to an existing row by the source's record id when it names one, else by overlapping time, so a session from both sources or from two phones is one row.

history.text: Imported sessions are matched to existing rows by time, not by the source's record id, so the same session never appears twice.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the record id is tried first.

requirements.text: Health Connect and Garmin imports run only on Android.

history.text: Health Connect and Garmin imports run only on the phone.
history.reason: Version 1 said phone; any Android device runs them.

requirements.text: A new or changed session in Health Connect triggers a Garmin sync, if none ran within `garmin.hc-sync-interval`.

history.text: Movement in Health Connect triggers a Garmin sync, if the last one is stale.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: syncs triggered by Health Connect have their own, shorter limits.
